name: documentos_pagina_25
sql: explain(analyze,buffers,format json)with actor as materialized(select set_config('request.jwt.claim.sub',(select m.user_id::text from public.memberships m join public.user_roles r on r.organization_id=m.organization_id and r.user_id=m.user_id where m.organization_id='<UUID>' and r.role in('admin','engenharia')order by m.user_id limit 1),true) as claim) select octet_length(public.nr_consultar('<UUID>','NR33','documentos',jsonb_build_object('unidade_id',(select unidade_id from public.nr_documentos where organization_id='<UUID>'group by unidade_id order by count(*)desc limit 1),'pagina',0,'limite',25))::text)as payload_bytes from actor;
